state.policy: Refunds: full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, store credit only. Agents may not promise dates for engineering fixes.
state.customer_message: I bought the annual plan 10 days ago and it does not work with our scanner. I want my money back.
state.agent_reply: Sorry about that! I have started a full refund to your card; you will see it in 5 to 10 business days. If you want to try again later, our scanner support list is on the help page.
